scenario: A partial refund (scenario-analysis.md #12, revised 2026-08 per ADR-0008 — refunds are ExpenseAdjustments against the original Expense, which is never mutated)

original_expense.note: amount_inr stays 900.0 forever, even after the refund below — gross, historical, immutable once APPROVED (invariants.md #6).

original_allocation_v1.note: Sums to 900.0 = netAmount before any adjustment existed (netAmount == gross amount when there are no adjustments yet).

original_allocation_v2.note: Supersedes original_allocation_v1 (invariants.md #6). Sums to 750.0 = domain.netAmount(expense) = 900.0 - 150.0, satisfying invariants.md #11 exactly — this is the arithmetic that was ambiguous in the pre-2026-08 version of this fixture (the original Expense.amount was never shown changing while the allocation summed to only 750). The refund's reduction was distributed proportionally across all three beneficiaries by explicit decision, not by a silent default (scenario-analysis.md #12).
